title: Retail packaging program expanded
excerpt: New tub, blister, carded-pack and box formats are now available for the DIY channel, each with custom layout design and shelf-ready graphics.
body: We have expanded our retail packaging program with new tub, blister, carded-pack and box formats designed specifically for the DIY channel.
Each format is available with custom layout design and shelf-ready graphics, so fasteners are presented in a way that helps them sell on shelf.
Packaging development now happens in parallel with fastener production, allowing customers to move from spec to shelf-ready product faster.
